# bits/bor_assign

> Bitwise-or assignment: x |= y, short for x = x | y.

truck [bits](../bits.md) · [source](../../../registry/bits/bor_assign.pkg)

```
let flags = 1
flags |= 4
print flags       // 5
```

The left side can be any place of type `int`: a variable, a field, a
slice element or `*p`, evaluated once.

## Syntax

Kind: `statement`

```
{x: place int} |= {y: expr int}
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `x` |  | — |
| `y` | expression | `int` |

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following
source, with `{slot}` replaced by what was written there, and compiled again.

*{$p} = *{$p} | {y}
